text:
Congratulations on your wife receiving the A5!
1. Yes it is the employer's responsibility. She should notify her employer ASAP that she now has an A5 - she will need to fill out a new tofes 101.
2. The employer will need to cancel the private insurance plan, but you wife will need to go formally complete her new HMO enrolment after her Bituach Leumi enrollment is approved (she should bring her ID card). She may wish to hold off having the plan canceled until she has enrolled, to avoid any "gaps" and to ensure they can merge her accounts (if staying with Maccabi).   
3. For the supplementary insurance, your wife will need to talk about this her HMO.  There may be a waiting period between enrolling for the first time and being able to purchase supplementary insurance, but the HMO should be happy to help with this.
